title: Obtainability audit: what is never obtained, in any era
note: Step `--pass obtain` (lib/obtain.mjs). Starts from every world source the pack has today in any era and every recipe of any tier, and lists the items and fluids of the audited namespaces that are never obtained, grouped by material and classified A (give it a source), B (arrives with a later era from docs/journey.md: hide until then) or C (will never arrive: hide it with its recipes). Inherits from steam the recipe types with no machine, the aliases, the tools, the boilers and the steam machines.

world.note: GTM's rubber trees in the Overworld and the sticky resin they drop.
GTM 7.5.3 GTPlacedFeatures/GTBiomeModifiers: marble and red granite patches in the Overworld.
The Moon's ground (gcyr:luna, by hand at the end of HV since v0.5.0): the lunar drill's regolith sample needs regolith and lunar sand (data/grindless/tables/veins_moon.json).
Mars' ground (gcyr:mars, by hand with the tier 2 rocket at the end of EV since v0.6.0); the tripod's stone on Mars.

Venus' ground (gcyr:venus, by hand with the tier 3 rocket in IV since v0.7.0): the pressurized drill's stone, and GCYR's Venusian regolith, a falling surface block (the site casing; B1's hammer also makes it on Venus).
Mercury's ground (gcyr:mercury, by hand with the tier 3 rocket in IV since v0.7.0): the Mercury drill's stone, which any macerator makes Hermean regolith.
GTM's charcoal pile igniter burns logs in the world and leaves brittle charcoal: it isn't a recipe.
GCYR's station packager puts a keycard out with every packed station (SpaceStationPackagerMachine): it isn't a recipe. Shown since S0-3 passed (tables/stations.json enabled).
The facade cover comes from a special recipe (gtceu:crafting_facade_cover) that the analysis doesn't read.
STEAM-X1: the Horizon Collector and its shard are never crafted; the welcome quest The Horizon Collector gives them (EMI info page steam_horizon_collector.json).

GT--'s spintronic mainframe gets our recipe in UXV (docs/eras/uxv.md F2; package A5 writes its photonic hall row and deletes this rule); until then it stays hidden, and it ships in the same release as that recipe; GT--'s own recipe is cut in server_scripts/grindless/uxv/cuts.js

UEV-F1 registered SiC/SiC as a dust material, but UEV-A5 makes the composite only as grindless:sic_sic_plate in the CVI furnace (fibre preform densified in place; a ground composite is just SiC): the dust has no producer and no use; kept registered for saves

UIV-F1 registered Wf/RHEA as a material, but UIV-A3 makes the composite only as grindless:wf_rhea_billet (W fibre preform infiltrated with RHEA melt in the levitation melter c2; docs/eras/uiv.md line 7): a W-fibre composite cannot be melted or ground back into a plain alloy, so the loose forms have no producer; kept registered for saves

UXV-F1 registered CoFeB, Co2MnSi and hBN as GT materials (uxv.md:1102), but the line makes them only as grindless:cofeb_ingot and grindless:heusler_ingot (UXV-A3's levitation melter, read by UXV-A2's powder bed) and UV's grindless:hbn_dust (UXV-A3's megabar row): the GT forms have no producer and no use of ours; added in an unreleased build, future use undecided

UV-F1 registered ytterbium metal (S0-8), but UV-A6 dopes the fibre preform with ytterbium oxide from the EV cascade's Yb strip and nothing reduces the oxide: the metal has no producer; kept registered for saves, future use undecided

UIV-F1 added a dust form to GTM's erbium, but UIV-A1's reductor c8 makes erbium oxide, which lines 16 and 44 use as is (Er:YSO boule, ErCl3 doping), and nothing reduces it: the metal has no producer; added in an unreleased build, future use undecided

UV-F1 registered thorium nitride as a material, but UV-A1 makes the nitride fuel assembly straight from thorium dust, carbon and nitrogen-15 (tables/thorium_fabrication.json, carbothermal nitridation inside the row): the loose material has no producer or consumer
GCYR's Dyson swarm parts stay hidden for good (docs/eras/uhv.md, Dyson swarm): our swarm is our own machines (UHV-B3), so GCYR's satellite, drone hangar and Dyson blocks have no recipe and no use
GCYR 0.2.9's satellites, GPS tracker, beam receiver and airlock door: no recipe and no deploy (docs/eras/luv.md, Considered and dropped: the satellites, the rectenna); they stay hidden

GTCA 2.2.0's elevator modules stay hidden for good: their previews have no bus or hatch (UHV-S0-8, UEV-S0-8 FAIL, docs/research/uev-s0.md), so any UEV module is our own machine; GTCA's test recipes are removed (integration/gtca.js)

casing for the OpV tier from docs/journey.md: GTM gives it no recipe; UXV-B6 only researches it and writes its assembly-line recipe, and the `opv` grant is what opens it, so it stays hidden until opv (UXV-F2; the UIV casing has its assembly-line recipe since UEV-B5 and the UXV casing since UIV-B5, the gates)
casing for the MAX tier from docs/journey.md: GTM gives it no recipe; held until max (UXV-F2 moved it off uxv, which would have shown it in v0.15.0)

GCYM-style parallel machine from Extended Features with no recipe (integration/extendedfeatures.js): the IV wave left them out (docs/eras/iv.md: GCYM at IV; the Expanded Assembly Line got a LuV recipe in QR-G0). A package that adopts one gives it a recipe, and the audit then finds it obtainable
GT--'s naquadria oxide mixture: only processing naquadria ore gives it, and no vein does (Venus's vein is naquadah and plutonium, IV-A1); naquadria itself comes out of the naquadah line

plutonium fuel for the GT-- naquadah reactor: needs neutronium mixture, which comes from a neutronium ore that no vein gives; UIV's neutronium is the RX J1856 pellet line, which makes no mixture, so it is held to UXV (docs/eras/uxv.md open question 18: a source there or class C)
hidden in EMI: only exists for old saves and converts into the new thing (empty vein probe); its conversion recipe stays
